newsitem.title: SPAIN: One person injured in Spain grenade attack - radio.
newsitem.headline: One person injured in Spain grenade attack - radio.

text.p: Two grenades exploded near a police station in northern Spain on Monday, injuring at least one person, state radio said.
Unidentified attackers launched the grenades at the National Police station in Oviedo, but they fell short of their target, according to the report.
It was not known whether the attack was carried out by the Basque guerrilla group ETA, which sparked national outrage earlier this month by kidnapping and killing a young Spanish politician.
Spanish security forces have often been targeted by ETA in its 29-year struggle for independence for the Basque country.
State radio said a woman was injured in Monday's attack.
Police found two grenade launchers in the area, and cordoned off the area in the search for suspects.
